task.title: P6-008: Align /login copy and chrome with the Desktop Sign in frame
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Visual and layout). Original id: P6-008. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-design.md.

**`/login` deviates from `Desktop — Sign in` on copy and chrome.** No logo line; heading reads "Sign in" rather than "Sign in to your collection" (`auth_pages.rs:292`); placeholders instead of `<label>`s; "No account? Sign up" (`:333-334`) rather than "New here? Create account"; and `← Back to home` (`:236-240`) where the frame names the affordance "Browse the catalog without an account →". The shared `BackHome` also serves the OTP and reset cards, so changing its label is not local to this screen. Desktop rail is `w-60` = 240 px (`shell.rs:447`) against the frame's 280.
